sources.title: anshubhatia1/bert-finetuned-complaint-classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: bert-finetuned-complaint-classification Fine-tuned BERT model for hierarchical classification of consumer financial complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) dataset. The model simultaneously predicts two labels from the complaint narrative: Product (21 classes) and Sub-product (86 classes).

sources.title: Phishing Detection with BERT - GitHub
sources.snippet: However, the emerging development of the field of artificial intelligence (AI) has allowed the introduction of various effective tools to combat this problem, including language models. This project proposes to train the BERT masked language model (MLM) for advanced phishing detection, through a process known as Finetuning.
